summary: Android| "No-results" screen
text: Added a no-results screen to the Android app for empty filter or search results. Android shows a no-results state.

summary: Android - Delegate/buyer list redesign
text: Redesigned the delegate and buyer lists in the Android app behind a Firebase on/off toggle, matching iOS. The Android app can show the new people-list design, switchable remotely via Firebase.

summary: Android - Exhibitor list redesign
text: Redesigned the Android exhibitor list, with a Firebase toggle to switch the new design on or off as on iOS. The Android exhibitor list can use the new design, controlled remotely via Firebase.

summary: Android - Products list redesign
text: Redesigned the product list in the Android app behind a Firebase on/off toggle, as on iOS. The new Android product list design can be switched on or off remotely through Firebase.

summary: Android - Brands list redesign
text: Redesigned the brands list in the Android app behind a Firebase on/off toggle, as on iOS. The new Android brands list design can be switched on or off remotely through Firebase.

summary: Android Sessions redesign
text: Redesigned session cards and session pages in the Android app to the updated design, with a pulsing Live tag, prices and a book button for paid sessions. Android session lists, free and paid session pages match the new design, including live indication and paid session booking.

summary: App builder -> Custom Documents block -> Hide " Download all" btn on preview
text: Hid the 'Download all' button in the app builder's custom documents preview. The preview matches the apps.

summary: Font in the app
text: Added the Gilroy font to the app builder's Heading and Text selectors. The chosen Gilroy font is applied in the Android and iOS apps.

summary: Login Link for App Sign In Page
text: Added mobile app handling for a /app-page/signIn link that opens the system login page from custom app blocks. The link opens the standard, OTP or web login page in the app, depending on the event's sign-in settings.

summary: Add an option in app builder to specify page for logged in / non logged user
text: Added a 'Visible only for users who are not logged in' toggle to custom block pages in the app builder's event info section. Custom block menu items with the toggle on show only to logged-out app users and disappear once they log in.

summary: Add app link to the app builder for the custom block
Change App builder form HTML to iframe
text: Rendered the app builder preview in an iframe to show the real app view. The app builder preview matches the app.

summary: Removing text blocks from the app builder
text: Removed workaround text blocks from the app builder. The app builder drops the old text blocks.

summary: "Re-sync" button to fetch the latest SQL data file manually
text: Added a Re-sync button to the app Settings page to manually fetch the latest data, limited to once an hour. All users can refresh app data themselves; logged-in users also see Cancel Registration and Delete My Account Globally.

summary: Deeplinks for Sessions
text: Added session URLs and deep links to session forms and the sessions export, opening in the app when installed. Organisers share links that open sessions in the app or web.

summary: Dynamic Event Handling for User Session Management: App
text: Made the app check on launch that the user's logged-in event is still in the backend event list. If the event no longer exists the user is logged out and shown an event selection screen, or the single available event's login.

summary: Change app icons
text: Unified the style and size of icons across the application. Application icons follow one consistent design style and size.

summary: iOS/ Please update the favorite icons, as their current quality appears quite low.
Mobile App - Add support for US English language
text: Added US English to the mobile apps, chosen by phone locale and initially a copy of UK English with 'Favorites' spelling. Users with a US English phone locale see US spelling in the app, such as 'Favorites' on My Profile.

summary: Arabic translation for mobile app
Multilanguage webview pages for mobile app
text: Passed the app's language code to the backend so mobile webview pages open in that language when the event supports it. Edit profile, floor plan, basket, exhibitor events and delegates webviews open in the app language if enabled, otherwise English.

summary: Android/ Made more user friendly behaviour of section closes
text: Kept the Android screen position stable when a section is collapsed with 'show less'. Collapsing sections on Android behaves like iOS.

summary: Mobile App - Replace Matchmaking Information Wording
text: Renamed 'Matchmaking information' to 'Profile Information' on public profiles in the mobile app. App public profiles label the section 'Profile Information'.

summary: In source code add res/xml/network_security_config.xml
text: Added an Android network security config so app requests can be inspected for debugging. Developers can inspect Android app traffic.

summary: Rotating Location Text on Button
text: Made long location text on session, exhibitor event, round table and speed networking detail buttons scroll horizontally in a continuous loop in the app. Attendees can read the full location on the button as it scrolls when it overflows, and it stays static when it fits.

summary: iOS/ Update "About me" section behaviour inside DELEGATES profiles
text: Hid the empty About me section on iOS delegate profiles. Profiles don't show empty sections.

summary: iOS/ Pls update "Tickets" page loading/updating behaviour
text: Added a loading spinner to the Tickets page update flow so users no longer think the app is frozen when updating. Loading/updating behavior on the Tickets page was improved with proper spinner feedback matching the original design, across iOS and Android.

summary: Add FBM Gabarito to remaining pages [Android]
text: Rolled out the FBM app's Gabarito typography to all remaining Android screens (~1010 elements across 451 layouts) for one consistent look end to end. Gabarito Semibold/Light configured platform-wide for FBM in AppBuilder; ~252 components (AppCompatTextView, TextView, MaterialButton, chips, radio buttons, text inputs) migrated onto the dynamic-font path; verified with no truncation/overflow on a smoke-tested set of high-traffic screens.

summary: Android/ Need dislay  Country/City on "choose event" and "logination" screens
Android/ Check events position ( current / past) on event selector screen based on event time
Expoplatform branding promotion in mobile app
text: The mobile app now promotes ExpoPlatform branding, turning attendee usage into organic platform awareness. ExpoPlatform branding is surfaced within the mobile app experience.

summary: Global Force Resync - Shoptalk
text: Reworking the mobile global force-resync so it no longer logs users out lets organizers fully reset event data mid-event (delivered for Shoptalk) without disrupting attendees. The admin-panel global resync was modified to perform a full reset/resync without logging users out, matching the in-app settings resync functionality.

summary: In-App Updates
text: Added in-app update settings to the app builder with critical (required) and desired (optional) update prompts. Organisers enable in-app updates and choose required or optional prompts, which the apps show when a newer version is available.

summary: Android/ Update "Favourite" icon behaviour in case of internet connection lost
text: Added a standard offline-connection toast when Android users tap Favourite while disconnected, replacing silent no-op behaviour. Tapping favourite while offline now shows the app's standard connection-lost toast across lists, profiles, and recommendations on Android.

summary: iOS/ Update "Favourite" icon behaviour in case of internet connection lost
text: Added a standard offline-connection toast when iOS users tap Favourite while disconnected, replacing silent no-op behaviour. Tapping favourite while offline now shows the app's standard connection-lost toast across lists, profiles, and recommendations on iOS.

summary: Tiered Menu Navigation for App Browser
text: Changed the app browser menu to a tiered structure with expandable, indented sub-items under their parent. Main items show first and sub-items appear only when their parent is expanded, with parents staying visible.
